question: M4 breakpoint at 2^20 bytes: S on both sides and whether crossing is worth it
number: Slack below 2^20 is 82,304 B (7.85 percent). Crossing by one doubling of the table (d=113, filed 32 B entries): total 1,516,704 B = 2^20.533, T -0.00529, memory term +0.533, S +0.527: not worth it. Halving (d=115): T +0.01052, memory term 0, S +0.01052. Every further DP bit gained costs a doubling (1 bit) and gives back under 0.011 bit of time (d=104: -0.0106 at 2^29). Crossing is never worth it; the useful move is to use the whole 2^20 (see M3).
notes: universe cell blake3-r3|MEM.DPTAB|MEM|M4. Ledger arithmetic as in M3.
